rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with eviction or non-renewal notices
rules.requirement: If your Boston landlord serves you a Notice to Quit or a lease non-renewal notice, you must get a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time, and the landlord must send a copy of the notice to the City's Office of Housing Stability. If you did not get it, report the violation to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity (617-635-2500 or 311) with proof of tenancy and a copy of the notice.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources delivered with Notice to Quit

coverage.summary: All landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of any unit in Boston; only residences in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, and non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facilities are exempt.
minor_exemptions_not_in_data: Residences in hospitals, skilled nursing facilities or health facilities
Residences in non-profit facilities providing short-term treatment for alcohol, drug or other substance abuse

rules.exemptions: Residences in any hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility; residences in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for substance abuse. Requirements cannot be waived by lease.
rules.penalty: Enforced by Inspectional Services Department: 1st offense warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.citation: Boston Code of Ordinances § 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
rules.quoted_span: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to Quit.

notes: Source is a City FAQ summarizing the Housing Stability Notification Act. The ordinance is a notice requirement for evictions/non-renewals; it does not require just cause to evict. Categorized under just_cause_eviction as an eviction notice rule. Citation 'Sec. 10-11.7' appears in the FAQ's penalty table and may refer to the enforcement/penalty section rather than the operative ordinance section.
